# Long Holistic Life

> Faith-centered whole-person wellness coaching and education for women, founded by Brittany Long.

Long Holistic Life helps busy Christian women build practical, sustainable health rhythms across nourishment, energy, rest, movement, environment, relationships, outlook, daily choices, and spiritual life. Its signature framework is NEW CREATION.

## Primary pages

- Home and free NEW CREATION guide: https://longholisticlife.com/
- Christian holistic health coaching for women: https://longholisticlife.com/coaching/
- NEW CREATION whole-person wellness framework: https://longholisticlife.com/new-creation/
- Christian wellness workshops for churches and women’s groups: https://longholisticlife.com/workshops/
- About Long Holistic Life and Brittany Long: https://longholisticlife.com/about/
- Educational guide to faith-based holistic health coaching: https://longholisticlife.com/learn/faith-based-holistic-health-coaching/

## NEW CREATION framework

N — Nourishment
E — Energy
W — Whole-Person Awareness
C — Choice
R — Rest
E — Environment
A — Activity
T — Trust in God
I — Interpersonal Relationships
O — Outlook
N — New Rhythms

Coaching methodology: Assess → Prioritize → Practice → Adapt → Return.

## Scope

Long Holistic Life provides health and lifestyle education, coaching, reflection, habit support, accountability, workshops, and group wellness education. It does not diagnose disease, prescribe medical treatment, provide psychotherapy, or replace care from qualified licensed medical or mental-health professionals.
